display_name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 8% all elemental dmg per 4s Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: An educational tome written by anonymous early inhabitants who worshiped the wind. It has been blessed by the wind for its faithfulness and influence over the millennia.

refinements.1: Increases Movement SPD by 10%. When in battle, gain an <r>8%</r> Elemental DMG Bonus every 4s. Max 4 stacks. Lasts until the character falls or leaves combat.

fr.flavor: Un ouvrage religieux rédigé par les premiers serviteurs de l'Archon Anémo. L'œuvre, qui a porté le message de l'Archon et sa bienveillance à travers le millénaire, a reçu la bénédiction des vents.
